components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Outlined active lavender navigation with real count.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:6px;width:190px;background:var(--ground,#f5efff);padding:12px}.ds-nav button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;padding:10px 12px;min-height:40px;font:500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text,#2a1647);cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#f0e5ff}.ds-nav .ds-nav-active{background:var(--active,#e8d7ff)}.ds-nav span{margin-left:auto;color:var(--muted,#695779);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#7937cf);outline-offset:3px}.ds-nav button{min-height:46px;border:1.5px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;transition:background 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease}.ds-nav .ds-nav-active{border-color:#2a1647;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #2a1647}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav button{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-panel{border:1px solid var(--border,#ddd0eb);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface,#fff);font:14px/1.6 'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--text,#2a1647)}.ds-panel h2{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin:0;padding:18px 20px}.ds-panel p{margin:0;padding:28px 20px;color:var(--muted,#695779)}.ds-panel footer{padding:15px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border,#ddd0eb);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#695779)}.ds-panel{background:#ffffffb8;border:1.5px solid #2a1647;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:4px 5px 0 #ddd0ed;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.ds-panel h2{padding:20px 22px}

narrative.overview: The supplied PaperGlass direction becomes a lavender/plum evidence workspace with translucent panels, firm outlines and crisp offset shadows. IBM Plex Sans keeps working controls legible. Source-derived documentation only; no browser-verification claim. Landing and authentication remain separate surfaces.

rules.name: Landing Surface Boundary
rules.body: The /landing section in DESIGN.md describes a separate local initial approximation with original procedural Three.js Water and particle art, light serif/italic headings and glass controls. It does not replace the dashboard system, claim exact reference fidelity or describe a deployed public page.

rules.name: Written State
rules.body: Retain written statuses and source provenance.

rules.name: Paper Glass Depth
rules.body: Use the supplied reference outline and offset-shadow vocabulary within the dashboard.

dos: Keep delivery history in Settings advanced disclosure.
Preserve keyboard focus and mobile navigation.
donts: Do not add fake charts, people or notification counts.
Do not claim visual verification from source inspection.
